what_it_is: A chemistry panel that groups common liver-related enzymes, bilirubin, and protein markers.
why_ordered: Monitor known liver or bile duct concerns
Often ordered with BMP or CMP
container: Gold/SST, mint green PST, or local chemistry tube
helper_cues: Separate serum or plasma as required
Hemolysis or icterus checks may matter by analyzer
memory_hook: HEPFA is the focused liver chemistry snapshot.
